_help: The equipment tooltip (official MapleStory art, UIToolTip.img/Item/Equip). All numbers are in game pixels, frame-local (the left frame is 324 wide, the set frame 298 wide). Left frame: marginX = the text margin; starsY = the top row of empty stars (11x10 each, three groups of five, then two); starBlockGap = the gap between star groups; starRowGap = the gap between the two star rows; nameY = the item name top; nameFont = the font size in px of the item name and of the set name; line1Y = the first divider; iconX/iconY = the icon box (82x82); iconScale = how many times the 32x32 item icon is enlarged inside the box; reqX = the left of the REQ text next to the icon; reqLvY/reqRow1Y/reqRow2Y = the REQ LV row and the two stat rows; reqCol2X = the second REQ column, relative to reqX; jobY = the job bar top (the official bar art is 14 tall); jobTextY = the job names top, relative to the bar; line2Y = the second divider; textY = the first text line under it; lineGap = the line pitch; descGap = the extra gap before the item description; descW = the description wrap width; portraitH = the blank area kept at the bottom for the portrait. Set frame (right of the left one): setGap = the gap between the two frames; setNameY = the set name top; setLine1Y = the divider under it; setPartsY = the first part row; setLineGap = the gap after the part rows before the second divider; setTierGap = the gap between two effect blocks; setPadBottom = the space under the last line.
